messages.subject: R1030 source audit complete
messages.body: I audited the immutable six-file QSA head-parallel snapshot and wrote the 9,088-byte decision-support report with source pins and primary citations. The source preserves the FP32 reduction tree under strict operation-order compilation, with no confirmed convergence or in-range address defect; the private active-bound mismatch and eager pooled reads are explicit API/input obligations. Main retains the independent parity oracle and owns compiler, runtime, performance qualification, and any integration decision.
